title: Figure 35: SSTO, 1 1/2 stage and 2 stage launch vehicle comparison drawings with weights
description: Three side-by-side profile drawings of launch vehicles labeled "SSTO" (2,370,000 lb), "1 1/2 Stage" (814,500 lb, with 301,000 lb and 512,000 lb components) and "2 Stage" (580,000 lb, with 80,000 lb and 500,000 lb components), each showing a hypersonic glider mounted on its booster. Caption: "Figure 35. Propellant Tanks That Are Not Reentry Vehicles Greatly Reduce System Weight. Venture star orbital maneuver rules." Appears under the heading "Launch Options."
